title: HOPE
synopsis: Reinforcements have been diverted to battle wildfires and all communication has been cut off. Hope’s police outpost chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae struggle to defend a village of the elderly, while in the mountains, Sung-ki and the locals who set out to track the beast find themselves hunted instead. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 《哭聲》名導羅泓軫，睽違十年傾力打造最具野心科幻鉅獻，黃晸玟、趙寅成、鄭好娟聯手國際巨星傾力助陣，康城驚世首映，引爆國際好評熱潮：一處偏遠小鎮，一則「猛虎出沒」消息，離奇事件急速擴散，某種超乎想像的可怕生物正在逼近。增援無望，通訊中斷，居民死守防線的同時，深入山林的搜尋隊卻反遭獵殺。異獸進擊，小鎮警號大響，在一場關乎生存、信仰與毀滅的末世災難中，誰在孤軍奮戰，誰望逆襲生天？

cast: Hwang Jung-min, Zo In-sung, HoYeon, Taylor Russell, Cameron Britton, Alicia Vikander, Michael Fassbender
